_comment: Location-based carbon intensity, gCO2e/kWh, generation-only convention, [P5, P50, P95]. Verified against eGRID2023 rev2 (latest as of Jul 2026 - no eGRID2024 exists), Ember 2024/2025 full-year data, Google region-carbon (2024), and corporate disclosures; see experiments/co2e/research/batch4/. ci_market only where the operator disclosed contractual factors.

ercot.label: disclosed
ercot.source: eGRID2023 ERCT = 334.1; solar/storage growth supports lower P5

virginia_pjm.label: disclosed
virginia_pjm.source: Google us-east4 2024 = 323.05 (Electricity Maps basis); eGRID2023 SRVC = 270.5 anchors P5

indiana_im_pjm.label: disclosed
indiana_im_pjm.source: New Carlisle = AEP I&M territory = PJM (AEP FY2025 10-K), eGRID2023 RFCW 415.5; I&M supply ~53% Cook nuclear anchors P5 (~280-350 utility basis). CORRECTED from earlier 'indiana_miso 700' which was wrong on ISO, subregion, and level; batch4/01+03

mississippi_srmv.label: disclosed
mississippi_srmv.source: eGRID2023 SRMV = 336.5; Entergy MS (Project Rainier MS campus); Ragsdale Solar 100MW PPA + new gas

pennsylvania_nuclear_ppa.label: reported
pennsylvania_nuclear_ppa.source: Talen/Susquehanna FOM PPA delivering since Apr 2026 (Talen 10-Q), up to 1,920 MW through 2042; P95 = eGRID2023 RFCE 271.8 grid basis

azure_us_ai_mix.label: derived
azure_us_ai_mix.source: Weighted Azure AI build-out (VA/AZ/IA/TX/WI/GA/WA/WY per MSFT FY25 fact sheet Table 15 + Fairwater sites; MROE-WI 637 pulls up); MSFT FY2025 implied location 324.9 / market 73.1 g/kWh; batch4/01

stargate_blend.label: reported
stargate_blend.source: Abilene mid-2026: grid-primary via 1GW ERCOT substation (ERCT 334) + 10 on-site SCGT turbines ~360MW operating (~584 g combustion + upstream); P95 covers the pending 41-turbine TCEQ permit scenario; Texas Tribune Jul 2026 + Epoch

aws_us_mix.label: inference
aws_us_mix.source: AWS legacy region blend (VA/OR/OH); eGRID2023 SRVC/NWPP/RFCW weighted

google_fleet.label: disclosed
google_fleet.source: Google 2026 Env Report (CY2025): implied location 347.6 / market 64.6 g/kWh; 42.42 TWh; CFE ~65%

montreal.label: disclosed
montreal.source: Google northamerica-northeast1 2024 = 5.48 (generation-only convention); Hydro-Quebec LIFECYCLE = 34.5 anchors P95. Also used as Canadian-hydro proxy (Kamloops BC, 5C/Hypertec QC). Corrected from 30 which was a lifecycle value in a generation-only table

china_grid.label: disclosed
china_grid.source: Ember CN 2025 = 526.2 (-30 g YoY on solar build-out)

china_ascend_hubs.label: derived
china_ascend_hubs.source: MEE 2022 provincial factors weighted for Huawei Ascend hubs (Anhui/Wuhu 678, Inner Mongolia/Ulanqab 685, Guizhou 499), scaled ~-8% for 2024-26 grid cleaning; MEE Announcement 2024 No.33; successor: MEE 2025 No.19 lifecycle CO2e PDF
